assertions.assertion: The patient presents with intermittent palpitations and episodes of dizziness that are concerning for underlying arrhythmia in the setting of known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency.
To correlate these symptomatic events with cardiac rhythm disturbances, cardiac event monitoring is ordered for further evaluation.
Cardiac event monitoring is coded as CPT 93271.
The diagnosis code I34.0 is used.
The diagnosis code R00.2 is used.
The diagnosis code R42 is used.
R00.2 supports the clinical picture of palpitations.
R42 supports the clinical picture of dizziness.
